purpose: Prepare past-only patient trend candidates and direct symptom intake for a separately reviewed experiment; no model fits
robust_scale: MAD / NormalDist().inv_cdf(0.75); undefined with zero dispersion
baseline_exclusion: Current decision day and latest measurement-end day excluded; all input availability must precede the decision
gap_handling: Missing observations remain missing; no future interpolation or forward-filled measurement days
interpretation: Changes, slopes and standardized deviations are descriptive features, not clinical severity or seven-day probabilities
